newsitem.title: UK: Forward Tech says still on recovery course.
newsitem.headline: Forward Tech says still on recovery course.

text.p: British electronics group Forward Technology, which issued a profit warning last December, said on Friday it was still on course towards 1997 being a year of recovery from the problems it had faced the previous year.
"We planned 1997 to be a year of rcovery from the problems of 1996. We are still on course to achieve that objective," company chairman Brian Chilver told the comapny's annual meeting.

Forward said elimination of some complicated contracts in the U.S. would result in lower sales for the electronic division but its results should improve over 1996 on better margins from its balance electronic turnover.
The company was, however, still facing competition in the sound and vision segment in 1997, it said.
"The market for compact discs has been particulary affected as capacity has outstripped demand," the company said.
The strength of the sterling and absence of a broad range of feature films on the UK market had also affected its video market.
The company said it was hopeful that its sound and visions sales would imrpove in the traditional pre-Christmas season.
